notes: Actual results reported to the State Comptroller for the fiscal year ending 2025-06-30, not an adopted budget.
Covers this government only. County, school-district and special-district taxes on the same bills belong to separate governments.
Left out of money in: transfers between the government's own funds ($101,315,045).
Left out of money in: permanent fund (trust principal) ($143).
Left out of money in: custodial fund (taxes collected for school districts, the county and others) ($205,805).
Left out of money in: private-purpose trust fund ($819).
Employee benefits ($193,586,860) are spread across departments in proportion to their size.

Political money counts PAC, business and union contributions to candidates for City of Buffalo offices reported to the State Board of Elections since 2022-10-20. Individual donors ($2,725,429 in the same period), candidates' own committees and party committees are not counted. Campaigns that raise little may not itemize, so some contributions may not appear.

Cameras: 133 license-plate cameras are mapped inside City of Buffalo's borders in OpenStreetMap (22 made by Flock Safety), not counting cameras tagged as run by stores, malls, schools or state and regional agencies. Flock cameras count as a red flag whoever runs them. Other brands count only when the government is the recorded operator, since many have no operator recorded.

Red flags: surveillance programs come from the EFF Atlas of Surveillance, a public database of news reports and public records, searched on 2026-10-20. A town or county with none listed may still have programs nobody has reported. Data center deals and corporate tax breaks have not been checked for New York yet. Most records carry no dollar amount, so each documented program costs a quarter of the red-flag points instead of being counted as spending.

Transparency: City of Buffalo has filed its annual financial report with the Office of the State Comptroller for FY 2025, the latest year most NY governments have filed. This is a check that the report was filed, not an opinion on its contents. The other five practices have not been checked yet, so they are left out of the score.
